title: Deep winter
text: Ice-hole fish are at their best. New secrets under the snow.

title: The long dark
text: A knitwear set for the lodge and a few quiet secrets.

title: Thaw
text: Spring Bloom opens on the 20th. A new visitor arrives with a story.

title: Bloom
text: River runs of shad and lamprey, and a new corner of the Far Isle.

title: Long light
text: Straw hats, and more to find on the shore.

title: Regatta
text: The Summer Regatta begins on the 15th: fast fish and a racing set.

title: High summer
text: A new reef chunk and bright secrets.

title: Late summer
text: A new islander with a questline; the last Regatta week.

title: Harvest
text: Harvest Festival from the 1st: lanterns, ghost variants and three new fish.

title: Grey days
text: Fog fish and a new channel through the mist.

title: Lights
text: Winter Festival from the 10th: the ice-fishing derby and a lights set.
